description: Documentation browser and help resource viewer for ChiSurf.

rpc_methods.name: help.docs.list
rpc_methods.summary: List all available documentation files with metadata.

rpc_methods.name: help.docs.read
rpc_methods.summary: Read a documentation file and return its content.

rpc_methods.name: help.docs.save
rpc_methods.summary: Save content to a documentation file.

rpc_methods.name: help.docs.search
rpc_methods.summary: Search documentation files for matching text.

rpc_methods.name: help.docs.ask
rpc_methods.summary: Answer a question from the documentation, citing the pages it read.
rpc_methods.description: Puts a question to ChiSurf's documentation and returns a grounded answer together with the pages it was taken from. Needs a language-model provider configured in Settings -> AI; the assistant can only browse, search and read documentation - it cannot load data, fit or run code.

rpc_methods.name: help.docs.contract
rpc_methods.summary: Return the Help plugin workflow contract.
